title: Distinguisher transfer under reduction
statement: Let the source and target be binary promise problems. If the source reduces to the target by a polynomial-time map preserving promised yes-instances and no-instances, and the target has a polynomial-time distinguisher that outputs true on every promised yes-instance and false on every promised no-instance, then the source has such a distinguisher as well.
hypotheses_covered: A polynomial-time promise-preserving reduction from the source problem to the target problem
A polynomial-time distinguisher for the target, correct on all promised yes-instances and no-instances
